name: Fuzheng Huayu (Chinese herbal formula)
short: Single-arm study (with other granules and entecavir): 10 of 251 had adverse reactions, mostly mild, all recovered or improved. Placebo trials: no significant (180) or drug-related (142) events.
text: Fuzheng Huayu is a Chinese herbal formula, given in the cited studies as tablets or capsules (one says it was taken by mouth); a 2018 meta-analysis describes the capsule as a product with six Chinese herbs but does not name them. In a randomized trial in people with compensated hepatitis B cirrhosis, entecavir plus Fuzheng Huayu tablets was compared with entecavir plus a dummy version for 48 weeks: no serious adverse events related to the study treatment occurred, and the rate of virological response to entecavir did not differ significantly between the groups (the abstract does not give patient numbers). In a placebo-controlled trial of the tablets in 180 people with cirrhosis following hepatitis (6 months), there were no significant adverse events. In a 48-week placebo-controlled trial of the formula taken by mouth in 118 people with hepatitis C at 8 US liver centres, the authors report it was well tolerated and safe; the abstract gives no event counts. In a placebo-controlled trial of the tablets in 142 people with lung fibrosis after COVID-19 (24 weeks, with vitamin C and breathing rehabilitation), no drug-related adverse events were reported in the formula group. A 2018 meta-analysis of 19 randomized trials (1,769 patients) of the capsules as an add-on to conventional treatment for hepatitis B cirrhosis reported no serious adverse reactions, and in a 48-week randomized trial in 80 people with primary biliary cirrhosis, no obvious adverse reaction was found either with the capsules plus ursodeoxycholic acid or with ursodeoxycholic acid alone. In an open-label single-arm study of 251 people with hepatitis B cirrhosis given Fuzheng Huayu tablets together with other Chinese herbal granules and entecavir, 10 had adverse reactions, most of them mild, and all recovered or improved. No other interaction data were found in the cited sources.
